Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR HUBS FOR CANE KNIVES 



1. Scope — Specifies material, dimensions and other requirements for hubs for boit and boltless type 
cane knives for use in milling plants. 

2. Material — Hubs shall be made of cast steel conforming to Grade 20-40 of 15:1030-1974 
'Specification for carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes ( second revision )\ 

3. Spokes and Dimensions — Spokes and dimensions of hubs used for cane leveller and cane 
cutter suitable for bolt type and boltless type cane knives conforming to IS : 8461 -1 977 'Specification 
for cane knives' for nominal diameter of 762 x 1525 mm mills are given in Fig. 1, 2, 3 and 4. 

Note — In Fig 3 and Fig 4, to have the advantage of reversal of knives, |the sequence of the top and bottom holes 
has been changed in the second set.

FIG. 1 CANE LEVELLER HUB FOR BOLTLESS TYPE KNIFE 

4. Other Requirements 

4.1 In case of bolt type, the holes should be reamed. 

4.2 The hubs shall be suitably mounted, key fitted, on the shaft. 

4.3 The hubs shall be free from flaws, seams, pits and other defects. All fines, burrs, flashes and sharp 
edges should be removed. 

5. Marking — The hubs shall be marked with the following particulars: 

a) Manufacturer's name or recognized trade-mark, and 

b) Code number. 

5.1 IS! Certification Mar/cing— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

6. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

7. Sampling for Lot Acceptance — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 15 March 1985
